supporting_observations.claim: Repeated failed logons for svc-grades were recorded on FILE-ORC-01 from 13:36 through 13:51 UTC. They recur at roughly one-minute intervals, use the same process ID, and identify FILE-ORC-01 as the workstation; the failures report bad-password status.
Domain-controller records also show bad-password or Kerberos pre-authentication failures for svc-grades from FILE-ORC-01 during this sequence.

The repeated FILE-ORC-01 failures are consistent with the supplied context that svc-grades runs every minute on that server and its password was scheduled for rotation at 13:30 UTC; this is a plausible benign explanation, but the logs do not confirm the job's configuration or the rotation.

At 14:12 UTC, WS-ACOLE-01 recorded explicit-credential use targeting svc-grades at DC-ORC-01 by Meridian OpsAgent. This is a separate, unexplained use of the alerted account from a workstation, but this record alone does not establish whether authentication succeeded or whether the activity was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not establish whether the 14:12 explicit-credential attempt succeeded; an event showing the authentication outcome is not included.
The records do not show the svc-grades password change, the GradeSync job's configuration, or whether that job was updated after rotation.
The evidence is limited to the provided records and does not establish whether relevant events were omitted from the collection.
claims_not_established: Whether the 14:12 svc-grades credential use from WS-ACOLE-01 was authorized or malicious.
Whether the 14:12 attempt succeeded or led to further access.
Whether the repeated failures on FILE-ORC-01 were solely caused by a stale GradeSync credential after the scheduled rotation.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve domain-controller and WS-ACOLE-01 authentication records around 14:12 UTC to determine the outcome and any subsequent activity for svc-grades.
Identify the owner, installation history, configuration, and execution context of Meridian OpsAgent on WS-ACOLE-01, and determine why it used svc-grades credentials.
Verify the svc-grades password rotation time and the GradeSync job's credential update and run history on FILE-ORC-01.
